_about: Aeschylus in English, translator per title. Complete in two translators: E. H. Plumptre (verse; Tragedies and Fragments) and John Stuart Blackie (verse, 1850; Lyrical Dramas). Also E. D. A. Morshead (verse; House of Atreus 1881 and Four Plays), T. A. Buckley (prose, Bohn), Gilbert Murray (Agamemnon, rhyming verse; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Murray d. 1957, not PD in life+70 countries). Publication years are given only where checked in the file; Murray's per-play years were not, so they are left out. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report. Added 2026-10-03, four single-play Prometheus Bound translations, raw IA OCR: Augusta Webster's (1866), C. B. Cayley's (1867), Paul Elmer More's (1899) and Edwyn Robert Bevan's (1902). Janet Case's Temple Dramatists edition (Greek facing, undated scan) was not taken. Also four Agamemnons, raw IA OCR: J. S. Harford's (Murray, 1831; translator from the catalogue only), H. H. Milman's (Murray, 1865, with his Bacchae of Euripides), W. R. Paton's (Nutt, 1907) and Locke Ellis's (1920). Not taken: Trevelyan's Cambridge Oresteia (1920, Greek facing, OCR 0.51) and the Greek-facing school editions (Conington, Kennedy, Davies, Verrall, Goodwin).
